speak.prosody: Introduction Welcome to the world of Rich Dad, Poor Dad, inspired by Robert T. Kiyosaki’s best-selling book. Here, we dive into the powerful ways early financial lessons can shape our lives—and how two very different father figures can influence the way we think about money. Imagine growing up with two dads, each with their own beliefs about what it means to be successful. One father follows the traditional path: he values academic achievement and job security above all else. The other dad has a different outlook—he encourages independence, smart investing, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Through their contrasting perspectives, we get a closer look at the choices and beliefs that can either hold us back or set us free financially. As we follow along, you’ll hear real stories, practical advice, and thought-provoking questions about what it takes to truly build wealth. These lessons go beyond simply earning a paycheck—they challenge us to think differently about money, to stop working for every dollar, and to start letting our money work for us. Throughout this journey, you’ll discover how financial literacy, building assets, and having the courage to step away from the crowd can open new doors. Get ready to rethink what’s possible and unlock a fresh approach to personal finance—a path that leads not just to prosperity, but to lasting freedom.
